troop.definition:
n. a group of soldiers
n. a cavalry unit corresponding to an infantry company
n. a unit of Girl or Boy Scouts
n. an orderly crowd
troop.translation:
n. 军队, 一群, 一队
vi. 群集, 结队, 成群而行

troop carrier.translation: n. 运兵舰，运送步兵的水陆两用装甲车

troop in.translation: 成群结队地进来,鱼贯而入

trooped.translation: vi. 成群结队地走（troop的过去式与过去分词形式）

trooper.definition:
n. a mounted policeman
n. a state police officer
trooper.translation: n. 骑兵, 骑警, 伞兵

troopers.definition:
n. a soldier in a motorized army unit
n. a mounted policeman
n. a state police officer
troopers.translation: n. （低军衔的）骑兵( trooper的复数形式 ); 骑警; 骑兵的马; <美>州警官

troopership.translation: 运兵船, 军队运输船

troopial.translation: n. [鸟](中南美产的)黄鸟,黄鹂

troopie.translation: n. <口>列兵,士兵(津巴布韦和南非没有军衔的军人)

trooping.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Troop
trooping.translation: vi. 成群结队地走（troop的现在分词形式）

troops.definition:
n soldiers collectively
n a group of soldiers
n a cavalry unit corresponding to an infantry company
n a unit of Girl or Boy Scouts
n an orderly crowd
v march in a procession
v move or march as if in a crowd
troops.translation: n. 军队, 装甲部队, 骑兵队, 部队

troopships.definition:
plural of troopship
n. ship for transporting troops
troopships.translation: (troopship 的复数) n. 部队运输船
